Name: Ashbea
Summary: Named as the head of the house of fine-linen workers of Shelah's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 4:21: Named as the head of the house of fine-linen workers of Shelah's line.
LifeLesson: The mention of Ashbea in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
